content: JetBrains Mono self-hosting options: (1) @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono v5.3.x — variable font, single file, all weights, import in layout.tsx. (2) next/font/google JetBrains_Mono — auto-downloads and self-hosts at build time, zero config. (3) @fontsource/jetbrains-mono — static font files per weight. Variable font recommended for minimal bundle. Font version from source: v24.
